title: Lazar's work on power and propulsion in Project Galileo

tellings.quote: to know, like how Bob was on power and propulsion, you know, with Project Galileo.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, talks about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on unusual craft in Nevada in the late 1980s. Corbell says Lazar's job was on power and propulsion, meaning how the craft were fuelled and how they moved, inside something called Project Galileo. If true, Lazar would have been studying how those craft actually worked.
